changelog:
universal-theme v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill designed to help users deepen the artistic and universal meaning of their photos.
- Provides methods and specific steps to move photos from "pretty" to "meaningful," focusing on universal themes rather than individual moments.
- Includes real-world case studies to illustrate effective use.
- Clearly defines when to use (and not use) the skill, with boundaries against basic composition or technical questions.
- Based on insights from the New York Institute of Photography.
